scientific_integrity: Exact hypergeometric covariance, Hermite-chaos remainder estimate and Gaussian orthogonal decomposition supply proofs; finite reproducible tests are not extrapolations or independent mathematical certification.
scientific_limitations: The width is Gaussian-directional, not Haar-spherical; growing-rank crossover requires \(k\to\infty\) and \(k=o(n)\). Historical priority provisional: a general variable-order U-statistic theorem or inaccessible width paper could subsume the conclusion.
title: A square-root-rank crossover in Gaussian widths of uniform hypergraph degree zonotopes
